settings.text: We develop C41 colour negative, black & white, and ECN-2 cine film in 35mm and 120 formats. We only use genuine Kodak chemistry, and run quality checks every time our machines power on.

settings.card_desc:
Ideal for social media use, or prints up to 4×6. Each
frame is expertly colour and density corrected by our technicians.

Our most popular, high-resolution scans - perfect for all online uses, and printing up to A3. Each frame is expertly colour and density corrected by our technicians. Delivered in either our default finish or a flat (low-contrast) option.

Each scanned folder is conveniently named after the film stock you used.

Our highest-resolution scans, ideal for flexible post-processing and prints up to A2. Each frame is expertly colour and density corrected by our technicians. Delivered in either our default finish or a flat (low-contrast) option.

Each scanned folder is conveniently named after the film stock you used.

Also available as 16-BIT TIFF.

*Pixel Dimensions quoted are Noritsu. Frontier approx 5400 x 3650

settings.scan_sizes_note:

from socials to gallery-sized prints.

‘Business Days’ are Monday to Saturday

settings.block_text: Our default scanners for all scan sizes are our top-of-the-line Noritsu HS-1800 and LS-1100 scanners. We give you the freedom to select from our classic scanners from the golden era of film:
settings.points:
Noritsu – High detail, balanced scans with natural colour  with
excellent sharpness.,,Fujifilm Frontier – Smooth tonal transitions with rich, vibrant
colour and beautiful skin tones.,,Kodak Pakon – A nostalgic look from the heyday of Kodak film labs. See your film as Kodak intended !

settings.block_text:
Our goal is simple: to deliver the perfect scans for your personal workflow.
For ‘Standard’ (Large) and ‘Pro’ (XL) sized scans, let us know your scan contrast preference (Default or Flat). Whatever you choose, your scans will always be consistent and premium quality.

By default, we cut and sleeve 35mm negatives in strips of six and store for three months. Collect them during reception hours, or we’ll happily post them out to you at your request.
Need you negatives uncut? Just let us know.
Already have developed negatives? We can re-scan them in any of the sizes above, and with our usual choice of scanners and scan-preferences.
We offer develop-only service for C41 and B&W

settings.card_desc: Processed on the legendary Noritsu V30 processors - our machines are meticulously maintained. We perform quality control checks at every startup, and use only genuine Kodak chemistry.

Developed on semi-automatic JOBO equipment using single-use chemistry, ensuring your film is processed in freshly mixed solutions every single time. We use Kodak X-Tol developer for fine grain and
excellent sharpness.
